objective_for_doctor:
Age: 17
Sex: M
Chief Complaint: nasal congestion

turns.content: Hello, I'm your doctor today. What brings you in today?
I’ve had nasal congestion and a cough with colored or more abundant sputum than usual. I also have wheezing when I exhale.

Thanks—one question at a time.

**Question 1:** How long has this been going on (days), and do you have a **fever** (measured or felt)?
I don't know. I’ve had nasal congestion and a cough with colored or more abundant sputum than usual, and I’ve noticed a wheezing sound when I exhale.
**Question 2:** About how long do you think it’s been—**less than 3 days, 3–7 days, or more than 7 days**?
I don't know.

No problem.

**Question 3:** Do you have **shortness of breath** at rest or when walking, or is it mainly the cough/wheeze?
I don’t know. I have a cough with colored or more abundant sputum than usual and I’ve noticed a wheezing sound when I exhale.
**Question 4:** Have you ever been diagnosed with **asthma or COPD**, or do you have a history of similar wheezing episodes?
Yes—I have COPD.
**Question 5:** Is this wheezing/cough **worse than your usual COPD baseline**, and have you needed **more rescue inhaler** than normal?
I don’t know. I have COPD, and I’ve noticed a wheezing sound when I exhale, along with nasal congestion and a cough with colored or more abundant sputum than usual.
**Question 6:** Any **chest pain**, especially with breathing, or any **leg swelling**?
Yes—I have pain in my lower chest and the side of the chest (right) and breast (left), and my pharynx, with a pain intensity of 3/10.
**Question 7:** Is the chest pain **pleuritic** (worse with deep breath or coughing) or more like **pressure/tightness**?
I don’t know. The pain feels sensitive and burning, and it’s in my lower chest and the side of the chest (right), breast (left), and my pharynx.
**Question 8:** Do you have **heartburn/reflux** symptoms (burning behind the breast, sour taste), or does the burning improve when you take antacids?
I don’t know. I do have burning pain in my lower chest and the side of the chest (right) and breast (left), and my pharynx.
**Question 9:** Any **sore throat** or **difficulty swallowing**, drooling, or muffled “hot potato” voice?
I don’t know.
**Question 10:** Any **fever/chills**, or feeling very unwell?

I don’t know. I haven’t been able to tell about fever or chills—I’ve mainly noticed nasal congestion or a clear runny nose, a cough with colored or more abundant sputum than usual, wheezing when I exhale, and burning/sensitive pain (about 3/10) in my lower chest and the side of the chest (right) and breast (left), and my pharynx.
**Question 11:** Is the sputum **yellow/green** or **bloody**? And is the cough **worse at night** or when lying flat?
I don't know. I’ve had a cough with colored or more abundant sputum than usual, but I’m not sure if it’s yellow/green or if there’s any blood.
**Question 12:** On a scale of 0–10, how bad is your **shortness of breath** right now (or do you feel you can speak full sentences)?
I don’t know. I’ve noticed a wheezing sound when I exhale, and a cough with colored or more abundant sputum than usual, along with nasal congestion or a clear runny nose.
**Question 13:** Have you had any **recent exposure or trigger**—smoke, dust, new medications, recent viral illness, or sick contacts?
I smoke cigarettes.
**Question 14:** Any history of **blood clots**, recent **long travel/immobility**, recent **surgery**, or **leg swelling/pain**?
I don’t know. I haven’t noticed anything like blood clots, recent long travel/immobility, recent surgery, or leg swelling/pain.

[ABSTAIN] Key discriminating details are missing (duration/fever, severity of dyspnea, sputum color/blood, pleuritic vs reflux-related nature of pain, and whether wheeze is worse than baseline COPD). With these unknowns, I can’t confidently rank the most likely diagnoses.

[POSSIBLE] Acute COPD exacerbation / infection, Bronchitis, Pneumonia, Bronchospasm / acute asthma exacerbation, GERD
